name: starcraft-ds
description: AI screen-capture counter coach for StarCraft II

scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix client
scripts.dev: npm run kill-ports && node scripts/ensure-ollama.cjs && concurrently -n server,client -c blue,green "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client"
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix server && npm run build --prefix client
scripts.electron:dev: npm run kill-ports && node scripts/ensure-ollama.cjs && concurrently -n server,client,electron -c blue,green,magenta "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client" "wait-on http://localhost:5173 http://localhost:3847/api/health && electron electron/main.cjs"
